paragraphs.text: Split-hand/foot malformation-6 (SHFM6) is an autosomal recessive limb malformation. It involves central reductions of the feet, with or without involvement of the hands, and expression varies within families. Several families with affected sibs born to consanguineous parents have been reported. SHFM6 is caused by homozygous mutation in the WNT10B gene.

checks.evidence_quote: A variable intrafamilial expression of the malformation pattern is apparent.
checks.explanation: The abstract directly states that expression varied within the family.
